purpose: Narrow the Casma N7 recovery gate to the documented official Pfafstetter dataset without promoting any geometry until exact vector bytes are retrieved and QAed.

official_dataset_identity.title: Delimitacion y codificacion de unidades hidrograficas del Peru

admissible_claims: the official attribute structure is documented under Uh_pfas100.dbf
the dataset includes Pfafstetter levels N1 through N8, unit names and areas
the source scale is 1:100000 and the official hydrographic-unit product is vector
ANA maintains an official spatial-data portal for hydrographic units and supports interoperable/download services

documentary_sources.institution: Secretaria de Gobierno y Transformacion Digital / ANA
admissible_claims: the national geoservice catalog currently lists ANA Unidades Hidrograficas with WMS and WFS services

required_before_publication: retrieve official ANA/INRENA vector bytes from an institutional download or WFS endpoint
select exactly NIVEL_7 codes 1375961 through 1375969 without geometry editing
verify code, name, area and topology against the 2007 Casma study
normalize to GeoJSON with explicit CRS transformation provenance if needed
run geometry validity, non-overlap/topology and area-tolerance QA

forbidden: trace the 2007 PDF map as final N7 geometry
use the N6 Casma polygon as a child substitute
edit official child boundaries to fit event outcomes
infer outlets from settlements or impact points
treat source availability as successful retrieval before exact bytes are frozen
